title: Pre-registration — E6/E7 supplementary absolute-accuracy variants for the 40q flagship
frozen_by: committing this file + src/e6_dmrg_extrap_40q.py + src/e7_semistochastic_pt2.py BEFORE any production run (git history = tamper-evident timestamp). e7 self-check (synthetic, non-production) may run first; no E6 production and no E7 40q result exists at freeze time.
relationship_to_e3: SUPPLEMENTARY and independent. The pre-registered E3 PT2 certificate (box A) remains the primary route and is reported unchanged whatever its terminal (convergence / OOM / deadline). E6/E7 are two additional, equally rigorous roads to the SAME scientific claim — that the 40q QSCI variational energy is absolutely (near-FCI) accurate — offered as 'we also tried these' evidence, never as a replacement or a moved threshold.
motivation: E3 certifies from the inside (grow QSCI space, EN-PT2 -> FCI) but is slow + RAM-heavy at 40q late iterations. E6 anchors FCI(40q) independently (classical, OOM-safe); E7 estimates E3's own PT2 far cheaper (stochastic, OOM-safe).

E6_dmrg_extrapolation.method: block2 DMRG on the identical H20/40q Hamiltonian (qsci_lib.hchain_problem(20) integral path) at a chi-ladder; extrapolate energy to the truncation-free limit; certify box A's committed E_var against it.
E6_dmrg_extrapolation.dmrg_schedule: FROZEN, identical to e1_chi800_counteraudit.run_dmrg: n_sweeps=8, bond_dims=[100,150,200,chi,chi,chi,chi,chi], noises=[1e-4,1e-5,1e-6,1e-7,0,0,0,0], thrds=[1e-8]*8, SU(2). chi=400/800 rungs must reproduce the committed h20_40q_dmrg_chi400/800 references.
E6_dmrg_extrapolation.extrapolation_model: linear E = E0 + slope * x, x = final-sweep discarded weight (dw); fallback x = 1/chi^2 if the block2 build does not expose dw.
E6_dmrg_extrapolation.fit_gate: accept the E0 (=FCI estimate) only if >= 3 rungs and R^2 >= 0.98; the extrapolation uncertainty is the intercept standard error.
E6_dmrg_extrapolation.decision_rule: report absolute_error = (E_var_committed - E0)*1000 mHa AS-MEASURED. chemical-accuracy demonstrated if |absolute_error| <= 1.6; prediction-i-equivalent if <= 0.5. E_var is box A's latest committed iteration at read time (results/e3_certificate_evidence.json); as box A grows, E_var descends and the gap closes.
E6_dmrg_extrapolation.honest_caveat: DMRG-extrapolated FCI is an estimate with a fit uncertainty (reported), not a rigorous two-sided bracket; H20 is the DMRG-favourable quasi-1D case so the extrapolation is tight here. Standard SHCI/DMRG practice, stated as such.
E6_dmrg_extrapolation.resources: chi=800 measured at 375 s / 9.26 GB (committed); ladder to chi<=2400 fits ~128 GB, est. 1-3 h total. Runs on a fresh CPU box, fully independent of box A (does NOT need box A's un-checkpointed space).

E7_semistochastic_pt2.method: Horvitz-Thompson bucket-subsample of E3's exact hash-bucketed EN-PT2: sample k of B buckets uniformly without replacement, PT2_est = (B/k) * sum_{sampled} pt2_b (each pt2_b from e3_certificate_40q._pt2_one_bucket, reused verbatim).
E7_semistochastic_pt2.properties_frozen: UNBIASED (E[PT2_est] = PT2_exact); time ~ k/B and peak RAM ~ 1/B of the deterministic PT2 (OOM-safe); at k=B it is EXACTLY the deterministic E3 PT2 (bit-identical by construction). Report PT2_est +/- sigma (finite-population HT standard error).
E7_semistochastic_pt2.self_check: src/e7_semistochastic_pt2.py --selfcheck — validates unbiasedness, that reported SE tracks empirical spread, and k=B exactness. PASSED at freeze (synthetic per-bucket contributions; non-production).
E7_semistochastic_pt2.decision_rule: if deployed on a 40q run, report E_var + PT2_est +/- sigma AS-MEASURED; prediction-i-equivalent if the estimate + its error bar sits within 0.5 mHa of E_var's converged limit.
E7_semistochastic_pt2.deployment_caveat: needs the QSCI variational space (like E3); box A's space is not checkpointed, so E7 cannot attach to box A's live run. Deployed only on a fresh growth run (skipping the expensive deterministic intermediate PT2) or as a drop-in for any future run. Offered as a validated method + tool, not necessarily launched.
E7_semistochastic_pt2.status_at_freeze: estimator validated (self-check PASS); no 40q production result

reporting_rule: All E6/E7 outcomes reported as-measured, pass or fail, with full ladders/error bars in evidence. These do not alter E3's pre-registration or any judged claim; they are labeled supplementary wherever cited.
